parameters.jsonQuery: ={{ JSON.stringify({ organization_id: $json.organization_id, from_date: String(new Date().getFullYear()) + '-01-01', to_date: new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: ($json.timezone || 'Africa/Lagos') }).format(new Date()), cash_based: true }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const p = $json; const b = { account_id: p.account_id, paid_through_account_id: p.paid_through_account_id, date: p.date, amount: p.amount, description: p.description, is_inclusive_tax: false }; if (p.tax_id) b.tax_id = p.tax_id; if (p.reference) b.reference_number = p.reference; return b; })()) }}

={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const p = $json; const line = { name: p.description.slice(0, 100) || 'Service', account_id: p.account_id, rate: p.amount, quantity: 1 }; if (p.tax_id) line.tax_id = p.tax_id; const b = { vendor_id: p.vendor_id, date: p.date, line_items: [line], is_inclusive_tax: false }; if (p.reference) b.reference_number = p.reference; return b; })()) }}

={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const p = $json; const line = { name: p.description.slice(0, 100) || 'Service', rate: p.amount, quantity: 1 }; if (p.tax_id) line.tax_id = p.tax_id; return { customer_id: p.customer_id, date: p.date, line_items: [line], is_inclusive_tax: false }; })()) }}
